name: Blessing of Nion [Ogham]
body:
Your ties to the ash tree grant you insights to matters of both spiritual and natural significance.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 insight bonus to perception skill checks involving nature or areas of spiritual focus (including temples or areas enhanced with positive or negative energy) as well as Knowledge (nature) and Knowledge (religion) skill checks. You may choose Knowledge (nature) or Knowledge (religion) and add one as a class skill.
